longDescription: This complete historical edition offers room to follow the author’s voice, setting and central concerns at their original pace. Character, social circumstance and the choices people make are part of its enduring appeal. The source edition retains its period language and introductory material; explore the credited source for publication and edition details.

authorInfo.bio: Edgar Allan Poe was an American writer, poet, editor, and literary critic who is best known for his poetry and short stories, particularly his tales involving mystery and the macabre. He is widely regarded as one of the central figures of Romanticism and Gothic fiction in the United States and of early American literature.
